title: Independent evaluation protocol for evidence-trace assistance

scope.holdout_scope: The new documents and four questions have not been used in previous runs or exposed to production implementers before runtime freeze. They are same-field public papers, not proof of unseen-domain or pretraining-free generalization.

freeze_and_access.custodian: Independent fixture/report agent; no production edits or retrieval-output inspection on holdout before freeze.
freeze_and_access.before_runtime_freeze: To the coordinator/implementers disclose only fixture/protocol paths and SHA-256, paper IDs/URLs/download status, and counts. Do not disclose new questions, gold facts, scoring pages, candidate packs or holdout preparation outputs.
freeze_and_access.freeze_order: First freeze PDF bytes, fixture and this protocol; record file and canonical fixture SHA-256. Freeze runtime code/config and archive them before coordinator reads new-question text/gold or initiates any holdout preparation/generation.
freeze_and_access.after_runtime_freeze: Holdout may be ingested and evaluated by the frozen runner. No code, thresholds, gold, questions or split changes in response to holdout outputs. Any subsequent revision is a separate development run and needs a fresh holdout for a new generalization claim.
freeze_and_access.old_question_reclassification: All eight old main questions are development_regression, including the four previously called new_question_no_tuning. Old question text, facts, pages and forbidden claims remain unchanged.

baseline_and_treatment.baseline: Fresh same-run assistance OFF using the retained legacy selector; never substitute historical outputs.
baseline_and_treatment.treatment: Fresh same-run assistance ON using the frozen evidence-trace selector.
shared_controls: Same pinned PDF bytes and parse/chunk identities within each pair; no fixture facts or evaluation notes indexed.
Fresh per-arm project/session; empty history and memory; no answer cache, self-evolution or memory writes.
Same model/provider/generation settings and source budget in both arms. Record returned model, request counts, prompt/source digests and source IDs.
Separate document-vector prewarm for each arm before the answer timer; query encoding remains inside the timer.
Use serial alternating order, six OFF-first and six ON-first main pairs; retain recorded UTC dispatch order. No automatic retries.

model_and_budget.soft_limit_scope: Inherited conservative stop limit, checked between calls; an in-flight call can cross it. If it prevents completion retain all outcomes and report incompleteness, do not silently raise it or rerun.
model_and_budget.no_added_model_processing: Do not add generative LLM query expansion, summarization, grading, or repair calls to the product-runtime answer pipeline. Local embedding/reranking/translation costs must still be measured. A claim that ON adds no prompt/total model tokens is an empirical acceptance condition, not an assumption; report actual provider counts and every per-pair increase.
model_and_budget.review_cost_scope: Independent agent review is an evaluation activity outside the 26 Step-5 answer calls; it is not free runtime work and must not be presented as human or expert evaluation.

diagnostics.required_report: Call count, actual model, source count, activation, insufficient-evidence behaviour and separate usage/latency. No quality-win claim unless separately reviewed and clearly labelled.

quality_and_retrieval_review.rubric_source: Existing five-dimensional weighted rubric retained unchanged: 25 factual accuracy, 25 evidence support, 20 completeness, 15 scope/uncertainty, 15 usefulness; each 0..4.
quality_and_retrieval_review.blinding: Random-label packets reveal question, actual answer/source excerpts and original-paper scoring notes, but hide arm, algorithm, usage, timing and traces. Use a different candidate order for the second reviewer.
quality_and_retrieval_review.independence: Reviewers score separately without reading each other's annotations or messages. Average both weighted scores per question; repeated reviews are not extra generation trials.
quality_and_retrieval_review.retrieval_first: Before scoring the answer, label each required fact full/partial/absent from the supplied excerpts alone. Full requires all material components, subjects, relations, attribution and conditions. Compound facts remain compound; partial never counts as full.
quality_and_retrieval_review.answer_coverage: Record covered/partial/absent against the generated answer separately. A correct answer from memory does not validate supplied evidence.
quality_and_retrieval_review.irrelevance: Flag only wholly irrelevant source labels; preserve necessary context/conditions and mixed-source labels. Report macro per-question and micro pooled-label rates with denominators; neither is sentence-level precision or byte noise.
quality_and_retrieval_review.critical_errors: Keep exact flagged answer sentences and reasons visible outside means. Apply the retained rubric's critical-error rule consistently; do not hide a bad baseline inside a positive treatment mean.
quality_and_retrieval_review.disagreement_policy: Preserve both original reviews and disagreements. For conflicting required-fact or irrelevance labels, perform a separate blinded evidence-only adjudication against the cited original pages, without arm or aggregate scores. Publish original and adjudicated counts and reasons; weighted scores are not silently rewritten.
quality_and_retrieval_review.same_pack_consistency: Group exact supplied-evidence hashes within this run. Identical packs for the same question/frozen facts must have the same adjudicated retrieval labels even if generated answers differ. Do not copy answer-quality ratings across generations.
quality_and_retrieval_review.no_missing_as_zero: Unscored or incomplete annotations are unavailable, not zero. Incomplete reviewer coverage blocks a fully scored conclusion.
quality_and_retrieval_review.gold_validation: Fixture author checked primary PDF text plus rendered mechanism/table pages. This is agent verification, not independent expert ground truth.

per_split: Weighted quality mean/median paired delta and wins/losses/ties, dimension means, critical errors.
Answer fact covered/partial/absent counts and all-facts-covered question count.
Strict supplied-evidence full/partial/absent counts, macro and micro full rate, and all-facts-full question count.
Wholly irrelevant source-label counts and denominators, macro and micro rates.
Provider prompt/completion/total/cached/reasoning usage, means/medians and totals; cached tokens are a subset/detail of prompt counts, never added again.
Pre-model, local helper, full non-streaming HTTP model, post-model and total answer wall time; no TTFT claim.
Separate clone, per-arm document-vector setup, actual once-per-corpus ingestion, and cold-start-equivalent allocation.
required_reporting.pipeline_diagnostics: Persist sufficient stage provenance to distinguish candidate absence, window loss, reranker scoring, threshold removal and final packing. Candidate count or high relevance logit is not completeness/entailment. If traces cannot localize a loss, say so.
required_reporting.all_call_accounting: Include diagnostic, failed, truncated and indeterminate calls; unknown usage remains unknown. Report actual model and finish-reason counts. No cherry-picked question or version pooling.

frozen_descriptive_acceptance.scope: A conservative descriptive quality/efficiency screen for this bounded run, not statistical significance or automatic deployment permission.
frozen_descriptive_acceptance.quality: Require non-negative ON-minus-OFF weighted quality mean and no ON critical error in each split; report per-question regressions even if means pass.
frozen_descriptive_acceptance.strict_evidence: Require no decrease in strict full-fact macro recall or all-facts-full questions in either split, and a positive full-fact gain on new_document_holdout. Partial evidence is not a substitute.
frozen_descriptive_acceptance.source_noise: Require no increase in wholly irrelevant-label macro rate in either split; also report micro counts and denominator changes.
frozen_descriptive_acceptance.runtime_tokens: Require no added answer-pipeline provider calls and no increase in mean prompt or total provider tokens in either split; disclose every individual increase.
frozen_descriptive_acceptance.interpretation: Failing any screen prevents a claim of a reliable no-extra-token quality improvement. Passing only nominates further validation; two held-out papers and four questions do not justify universal claims or default activation.

prohibited_actions: No production changes by fixture custodian.
No answer-model or paid API calls while constructing/finalizing the fixture.
No developer access to new question/gold content before runtime freeze.
No threshold tuning, selective reruns, question dropping, or gold editing after observing held-out outputs.
No claim that reviews are human, expert, independent generation repetitions, or statistically significant evidence.
